blocks.text: Bohr model ek one-dimensional (sirf ek simt wala) model tha. Atom mein electrons ki tarteeb batane ke liye woh sirf ek quantum number istemal karta tha. Us mein sirf orbit ka size aur energy aham thi, jo n quantum number se batayi jati thi. Schrodinger ke model mein electron three-dimensional space (lambai, chaurai, unchai wali jagah) mein reh sakta hai, is liye un orbitals ko batane ke liye, jin mein electron mil sakta hai, teen coordinates yani teen quantum numbers chahiye. Schrödinger ki wave equations se yeh teen quantum numbers aate hain: principal (n), angular (ℓ) aur magnetic (m). Yeh atom ke orbitals ka size, shape (shakal) aur space mein orientation (rukh) batate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ghar ka pata socheen: n batata hai kaun si manzil (shell, size aur energy), ℓ batata hai kamre ki shakal (subshell, shape), aur m batata hai kamra kis taraf hai (orientation). Chautha number, spin (s), aage aata hai aur ek orbital ke do electrons mein farq karta hai.

items: Bohr: ek quantum number (n). Schrodinger: teen quantum numbers chahiye.
n = size aur energy, ℓ = shape, m = space mein orientation.
